document_types.name: Policy
document_types.description: Company-wide rule or mandate; rarely changes

document_types.name: Work Instruction
document_types.description: Narrower/more technical than an SOP — single-task detail

document_types.name: Record
document_types.description: Evidence/log of something that happened — approvals, filled checklists, meeting minutes

document_types.name: Knowledge Base / Reference
document_types.description: Explains a concept, glossary entry, FAQ

document_types.name: Project Document
document_types.description: Charter, plan, or status doc tied to a specific project

document_types.name: Archived (status, not a fresh type)
document_types.description: A retired version of any type above — code and folder stay the same, only Lifecycle Status changes
